title: Vibe Aegis Scan Report
description: Deterministic output of `python3 scripts/aegis_scan.py <target> --json --output .aegis/scan-report.json`. CI pipelines and AI agents can validate scan output against this schema before acting on it.

version.description: Semantic version of the scanner that produced this report.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of when the scan completed.

target_path.description: Absolute resolved filesystem path of the scanned repository.

live_url.description: The live or staging URL passed via `--url`, or null when only a static scan was run.

scanned_files.description: Number of source files read during the static scan.

tech_stack.description: Fingerprinted stack. Each key maps to the list of detected technologies in that category; an empty array means nothing was detected for it.

readiness_score.description: Release Readiness Score from 0 to 100. Starts at 100 and subtracts 25 per CRITICAL, 10 per HIGH, 4 per MEDIUM and 1 per LOW finding, floored at 0.

release_verdict.description: Human-readable release gate decision. Begins with BLOCKED when any CRITICAL or HIGH finding is open.

summary_counts.description: Finding tallies by severity and by domain.

SUPPRESSED.description: Findings hidden by a baseline file or .aegis-ignore.

findings.description: All deterministic findings, pre-sorted by severity (CRITICAL first), then domain, file and line.

stages.description: Which analysis stages actually ran, e.g. static, diff:origin/main, git-history, dependencies, artifacts, live-url, baseline:<n>.

dependencies_parsed.description: Number of dependencies parsed from lockfiles and manifests (0 when the dependency stage did not run).

rule_id.description: Stable rule identifier. SEC/UX/LIVE are source and live-posture rules; PAY is payments and business logic; REL is backend reliability and scale; FLOW is data-flow (taint) analysis; DEP is dependency vulnerabilities; ART is build-artifact and mobile-package findings; HIST is git-history forensics.

domain.description: Which analysis stage produced this finding.

severity.description: Impact rating used by the Release Readiness Score.

title.description: Short human-readable description of the defect.

file.description: Repository-relative file path, or the probed URL for live posture findings.

line.description: 1-indexed line number, or 0 for findings that are not tied to a source line (live URL checks).

snippet.description: Trimmed evidence excerpt. Credentials are always redacted (first 6 and last 4 characters only) so reports are safe to commit and share.

cwe_or_standard.description: Cited authority: a CWE ID, an OWASP Top 10 category, or a WCAG 2.2 success criterion.

confidence.description: Scanner confidence before the adversarial Skeptic stage reviews the claim.

fingerprint.description: Stable 16-hex-character id derived from rule, file and normalised evidence. Used for baseline suppression and SARIF partialFingerprints; survives line-number shifts.
